strings.disable_food_degradation: Pauses the time left on your food while its healing continues. Eating and removing food still work as usual. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.no_carry_limit: Removes the carrying-weight limit. Wins over Custom Carry Weight while on. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.custom_carry_weight: Maximum carrying weight: 0 keeps the normal rule and equipment bonuses; 1–99999 sets an exact personal limit. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.unlimited_eitr: Actions ignore eitr costs, even without eitr food. Your reserve and food-based maximum are not refilled or changed. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.panic: Turns every Hex personal power off. Unassigned by default.
strings.unlimited_stamina: Unlimited stamina, including actions begun with an empty stamina bar. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.infinite_jumps: Jump again in midair. Each jump costs stamina as usual, and the usual combat limits apply.
strings.walk_speed: Walking speed percent (10–300). Sneaking speed stays with Saga.
strings.moon_gravity: Moon gravity: 20 percent gravity and no fall damage.
strings.enabled: Enables Hex. Each power still needs the server's permission for its category (see the Policy page).
strings.disable_durability_loss: Stops your equipment and tools from wearing down. Repairs still work; broken items are not repaired. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.god_mode: God mode: damage cannot take your health below 1 (the game's own immortality). Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.ghost_mode: Ghost mode: once the server confirms it, creatures ignore you in the game of every player who runs Hex. Players without Hex still see you. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.ghost_refused_inactive: Ghost Mode was not confirmed: Hex is not active on this server.
strings.ghost_refused_character: Ghost Mode was not confirmed: the server did not recognize your current character. Try again.
strings.ghost_refused_denied: Ghost Mode was not confirmed: this server does not allow your personal cheats.
strings.ghost_refused_capacity: Ghost Mode was not confirmed: too many players are already in Ghost Mode.
strings.ghost_refused_vanilla: Ghost Mode was not confirmed: this server refuses Ghost Mode while players without Hex are connected.
strings.ghost_revoked: Ghost Mode was turned off by the server. Your setting is kept.
strings.ghost_vanilla_setting: Ghost Mode while players without Hex are connected: Allow (default) keeps Ghost available, although creatures run by those players still see ghosts; Refuse turns every confirmation off while they are connected. Only the value on the computer hosting the world is used; changing it on another computer has no effect.
strings.fly: Fly with the game's own debug flight (jump to rise, crouch to descend). Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.noclip: NoClip: fly through terrain, buildings and objects. Turns flight on while enabled. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.freecam: FreeCam: detach the camera and fly it freely while your character stays in place. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.fly_speed: Flying speed percent (10–300), including NoClip. The game's sprint boost and console flight speed still apply.
strings.mounted_speed: Mounted speed percent (10–300), while you control and own the mount. Riding skill, stamina and turning work as usual.
strings.keep_items: Keep inventory and equipment on death, including worlds that delete items. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.keep_food: Keep remaining food on death. Food effects and the respawn save work as usual. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.keep_skills: Keep skill levels and progress on death, including worlds that reset skills. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.keep_status_effects: Keep status effects and their remaining time across the next respawn in this session. Does not carry effects into another character or world. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.quick_actions: Enables the quick-action commands. Each action still needs the server's permission.
strings.actions_help: Hex: hex heal; hex rested; hex power GP_Eikthyr|GP_TheElder|GP_Bonemass|GP_Moder|GP_Yagluth|GP_Queen|GP_Ashlands|GP_DeepNorth. Enable Quick Actions first. hex seed (Map Tools or Debug Tools). | hex map reveal | hex map reset confirm | hex skills | hex skill <ID> <0–100> | hex preset list/save/load/delete/reload | hex protection (Spawn protection)
strings.actions_unavailable: Quick actions need an owned living character, Hex enabled, and Quick Actions enabled.
strings.actions_denied: The server does not allow this action.
strings.actions_power_unknown: Unknown or unavailable boss power. Use the exact GP_ name shown in hex help.
strings.achievements_despite_cheats: Lets the game's achievements count despite character, world, item or mod cheat flags, while the server allows Progress cheats. The flags stay as they are. Steps aside for AchievementSync.
strings.clear_inventory_marks: Clears cheat marks on items in your inventory and on items you pick up, while the server allows Progress cheats. Items that could not be added keep their marks. Permanent; steps aside for AchievementSync.
strings.clear_container_marks: Clears item cheat marks in loaded chests you currently own and saves them as usual. Does not take ownership. Needs the server's Progress permission. Permanent; steps aside for AchievementSync.
strings.clear_drop_marks: Clears cheat marks on items lying in the world that you currently own and saves them as usual. Does not take ownership. Needs the server's Progress permission. Permanent; steps aside for AchievementSync.
strings.local_time_minute: Your local time in minutes after midnight (0–1439), or -1 for world time. Changes lighting only; the world clock, weather, day and night rules and other players are unchanged. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.local_time_freeze: Freeze the selected visible time; otherwise it advances with the world. Has no effect while Local Time Minute is -1.
strings.bouncy: Bouncy: jump or fall to bounce on landing. Pauses while chat or menus have the input. Stamina, attack limits and fall damage work as usual; Moon Gravity is separate. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.super_knockback: Super Knockback: your hits on creatures push them ten times as hard, with damage unchanged. No effect on players, buildings, trees or hits that do not push. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.party_hits: Party Hits: local colored confetti on your outgoing creature hits, fading over 2.5 seconds. No damage, network, world or other-player changes. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.player_size: Player size percent (25–300), relative to your current size, including size changes from other mods. Keeps size on chairs, thrones and benches. Returns to normal in bed, while riding or on ships, teleporting or dying, and comes back afterward. Other players see your size only if they run Hex. Needs the server's Personal permission.
strings.debug_tools: Enables debug information actions. Each action needs the server's Information permission.
strings.debug_unavailable: Debug information needs a living owned character, Hex enabled and Debug Tools enabled.
strings.seed_unavailable: World seed is unavailable in this session.
strings.seed_thing_required: Remote world seeds need Thing's seed admin command on your game and on the server.
strings.seed_thing_result: Thing handles the seed request and reports its own result.
strings.map_tools: Enables your local map actions. Changes are saved in your character's map. Needs the server's Information permission.
strings.map_help: hex map reveal | hex map reset confirm
strings.map_unavailable: Map actions need a generated map, living owned character, Hex enabled and Map Tools enabled.
strings.map_confirm_reset: Reset erases your local and received exploration fog, preserving pins. Use hex map reset confirm to proceed.
strings.map_operation_failed: The map action failed; the map may be partly changed.
strings.map_save_failed: The map changed but could not be saved. Try again before you log out.
strings.map_revealed: Map revealed and saved to your character.
strings.map_reset_done: Your explored and shared map areas were reset; pins kept. Map saved to your character.
strings.skill_editor: Enables editing your saved skill levels, including mod skills and skills you have not trained. Changes are saved with your character as usual. Needs the server's Progress permission.
strings.skills_help: hex skills | hex skill <numeric ID or stable identity> <level 0–100>
strings.skills_unavailable: Skill editing needs a living owned character, Hex enabled and Skill Editor enabled.
strings.skills_empty: No registered skill definitions are available.
strings.skills_level_invalid: Choose a skill level from 0 to 100.
strings.skills_unknown: Unknown, removed or ambiguous skill. Use hex skills for current IDs.
strings.skills_set: {0} set to {1}; progress toward the next level reset.
strings.preset_restore: Restore the selected preset once when your character enters a ready session. Denied choices remain preferences; server permission still controls every effect. Panic cancels restoration for this character/session.
strings.preset_help: hex preset list | save <name> | load <name> | delete <name> | reload
strings.preset_invalid: Preset file is invalid or unreadable. Existing contents were preserved; correct it and use hex preset reload.
strings.preset_limit: At most 32 presets can be saved.
strings.preset_write_failed: Preset file write failed or external contents changed. Reload before retrying.
strings.preset_apply_failed: Preset selected, but preferences may be partially applied or their config save failed.
strings.preset_loaded: Preset restored. Each effect still needs the server's permission.
strings.preset_saved: Preset saved and selected for future entry.
strings.preset_unavailable: Preset tools require Hex to be ready and active.
strings.menu_key: Opens and closes the Hex cheat window. Does nothing while you type.
strings.hotkey_description: Toggle {0}. Numeric keys restore the last non-neutral value selected during this session. Unassigned by default.
strings.hotkey_choose: Select a non-default value first; this shortcut then toggles it on and off.
strings.ui_policy_invalid: Invalid or excessive platform IDs. Use commas, semicolons or new lines.
strings.ui_policy_unavailable: You cannot edit the policy on this server.
strings.ui_policy_submitted: Policy change sent to the server.
strings.ui_policy_failed: Policy change failed; check the current value before retrying.
strings.poi_actual: Show actual boss and trader locations
strings.poi_thing_required: Actual locations require Thing on the server. Use Seed estimates for unconfirmed local estimates.
strings.poi_loaded: Showing {0} actual location markers on the large map.
strings.spawning: Enable item and creature spawning controls. Every spawn and inventory pickup needs the server's Economy permission.
strings.spawn_confirm_above: Ask for confirmation when creating more than this many units.
strings.spawn_busy: A spawn or inventory delivery is already pending.
strings.spawn_denied: Spawning needs the Spawning setting on, a living character and the server's Economy permission.
strings.spawn_unsupported: This item or creature, quality, level or tame option is not available.
strings.spawn_confirm: Create {0} units? Confirm before proceeding. For the console, append confirm.
strings.spawn_waiting: Spawn request sent; waiting for the server.
strings.spawn_failed: Could not confirm the spawn result. Anything already created stays in the world; do not repeat the request to recover it.
strings.spawn_delivered: Created {0}; Hex put {1} in your inventory. The rest are in the world or were picked up separately.
strings.spawn_help: hex spawn item <prefab> <amount> <quality> inventory|drop [confirm]; hex spawn creature <prefab> <amount> <level> tame|wild [confirm]
strings.spawn_canceled: Inventory delivery stopped. Created {0}; Hex put {1} in your inventory. The rest are in the world or were picked up separately.
strings.poi_estimating: Estimating locations: {0}/{1}. These are unconfirmed estimates.
strings.poi_estimated: Loaded {0} unconfirmed seed estimates. Existing saves and server changes may differ.
strings.poi_estimate_unavailable: Estimates unavailable: the world data is not ready, changed, failed or took too long.
strings.debug_mode: Enable Z flight, B free build, K kill and L drops shortcuts while playing. Each action needs its own server permission. The game's own debug shortcuts win when you turn them on separately. Hold Ctrl and middle-click the large map to teleport; hold Shift + C and move the mouse to change your local time of day and field of view.
strings.debug_confirm_kill_body: Run the game's killenemies command? It can kill loaded enemies and their spawners. The game's own cheat rules still apply.
strings.debug_confirm_drops_body: Remove item drops? On a host this removes the loaded drops you own. This cannot be undone.
strings.debug_timbers_owner: Free building belongs to Timber when installed, and on remote servers. Use Timber controls; Hex does not change its shared setting.
strings.debug_remote_kill: Remote enemy killing is not available on this server.
strings.debug_confirm_required: Confirmation required. Append confirm to the console command.
strings.debug_native_unavailable: The game command is unavailable or its requirements are not met. Check the game console.
strings.debug_native_submitted: Command sent; check the game console for the result.
strings.debug_native_uncertain: The result is not known. Nothing was retried; check the world before you repeat it.
strings.debug_help: hex debug fly | build | kill confirm | drops [confirm]
strings.debug_view: Time and field of view (Shift + C)
strings.esp: Show a local overlay for loaded players, creatures, drops, resources, pickables and dungeons. Needs the server's Information permission.
strings.import_unavailable: Import is unavailable: you cannot change these settings right now.
strings.import_guard_unavailable: Crucible achievement settings are unavailable; import them through their owner.
strings.import_preset_note: Creates a preset named "Imported VAT" (from Valheim_Admin_Tool) without selecting it. Your current selection and settings stay as they are. Only known settings are imported; unknown ones are listed.
strings.import_format_unknown: Unknown state-file format. A supported section/key config is required.
strings.import_owner: {0}: now controlled by {1}; use that product's converter.
strings.import_action_pending: {0}: this shortcut has no Hex equivalent and was skipped.
strings.import_unknown: {0}: unknown or outside this import's scope; omitted.
strings.import_unassigned: {0}: unassigned source shortcut; existing target kept.
strings.import_stale: Source, target or session changed. Preview again.
strings.import_collision_refused: A shortcut conflicts with an existing Hex or Crucible binding. Change it or choose a replacement, then preview again.
strings.debug_kill_busy: A remote kill request is already pending.
strings.debug_kill_waiting: Remote creature and spawner damage submitted to the server.
strings.debug_kill_refused: Remote creature and spawner damage refused or unavailable.
strings.debug_confirm_remote_kill_body: Damage loaded untamed creatures and spawners within 1,000 m? The server requires an admin and World permission.
strings.debug_drops_busy: A remote drops request is already pending.
strings.debug_drops_waiting: Remote drop removal submitted to the server.
strings.debug_drops_refused: Remote drop removal refused or unavailable.
strings.debug_confirm_remote_drops_body: Remove loose item drops within 128 m? The server hands each drop to the client that owns it. The server requires an admin and World permission. This cannot be undone.
strings.debug_remote_limit: Too many targets (more than 512) in range for one request; nothing was changed.
strings.spawn_protection_legend: Green: base protection or structural cover. Red: gaps. Loaded terrain within 50 m; requires Debug Tools and Information permission.
strings.help_catalog_category: Filter the catalog by item type or creature biome.
strings.help_catalog_reload: Refresh the item or creature catalog.
strings.help_catalog_search: Find catalog entries by localized name or exact prefab identity.
strings.help_clearpoi: Remove Hex location markers from your map; other pins stay.
strings.help_close: Close this window without applying another action.
strings.help_deletepreset: Delete this saved preset after confirmation; current preferences stay.
strings.help_esp_distance: Limit the ESP overlay to loaded targets within this distance in meters.
strings.help_esp_filters: Choose which kinds of loaded targets appear in ESP.
strings.help_esp_search: Show only ESP targets whose name or internal name contains this text.
strings.help_heal: Restore your character's health to its current maximum.
strings.help_hotkey: Choose or clear the keyboard shortcut for {0}.
strings.help_loadpreset: Load this preset's preferences; server permission still controls each effect.
strings.help_poi: Request actual boss and trader locations through Thing on the server.
strings.help_policy: Edit the server's category access or listed player IDs; requires permission to amend server settings.
strings.help_power: Choose and apply an available boss power status effect.
strings.help_reloadpreset: Reload saved presets from disk without changing the current preferences.
strings.help_reset_speeds: Reset all five movement speed preferences to 100%.
strings.help_rested: Apply or refresh Rested with a one-hour duration.
strings.help_reveal: Reveal and save your character's whole map.
strings.help_savepreset: Save current preferences under a preset name and select it for future entry.
strings.help_seed: Show the current world seed; remote requests use Thing's seed admin command.
strings.help_spawn_amount: Choose how many units to create, within the displayed range.
strings.help_spawn_editor: Open creation options for this item or creature; nothing is created until Spawn.
strings.help_spawn_level: Choose item quality or creature level within this prefab's supported range.
strings.help_spawn_option: Choose item inventory pickup versus world drop, or tame versus wild creature.
strings.help_estimatepoi: Calculate unconfirmed boss and trader location estimates from the seed; existing saves and server changes may differ.
strings.help_spawn_submit: Create the configured items or creatures; large quantities require confirmation.
strings.help_spawn_kind: Switch the list between items and creatures.
strings.seed_tools_required: The world seed needs a living owned character, Hex enabled and Map Tools or Debug Tools enabled.
